stem.en:
The Ashby book fair opens on Friday at noon and closes on Sunday evening. Entry costs three pounds on Friday and two pounds on Saturday, but on Sunday, the last day, visitors get in for free. Cloth bags for carrying books are sold at the door for one pound. More than forty sellers will have tables in the main hall, and a reading corner for small children will be open every morning.

How much does it cost to visit the fair on its final day?

options.en: nothing
three pounds
two pounds
one pound

why.en: "nothing": on Sunday, "the last day, visitors get in for free". Three and two pounds are Friday and Saturday; one pound is the price of a bag.
why.uz: «nothing»: yakshanba — «the last day, visitors get in for free». Uch va ikki funt — juma va shanba narxi; bir funt — sumka narxi.
why.ru: «nothing»: в воскресенье, «the last day, visitors get in for free». Три и два фунта — цены пятницы и субботы; один фунт стоит сумка.

why.ru: «2004»: «The town finally repaired it in 2004, and since then the bells have rung». 1979 — буря, 1887 — постройка, 2011 — музей.

Those with more energy can book the deep tour: it lasts three hours, and visitors wear helmets and crawl through narrow passages. why.uz: «three hours»: uzunroq ekskursiya — «deep tour» — «lasts three hours». Qirq besh daqiqa — qisqa ekskursiya, oʻn daqiqa — yurish, bir soat — kafe.

Their students met each new word in three short stories over a week and then used it once in a sentence of their own. A month later, these students remembered more words than a group that had copied lists.

Ten years ago, the farmers of the Ardel valley grew almost nothing but wheat. Then a run of dry summers ruined several harvests in a row. Some families left the land. Others began to plant crops that need less water, such as chickpeas and sunflowers, and a few started keeping bees. Farmers in the Ardel valley still grow almost nothing but wheat.
Keeping bees has now become the main work of most of the farmers in the Ardel valley.
Dry summers forced every family to leave the Ardel valley.

Asked why the new bicycle scheme in Corvel had failed, the planners at first blamed the weather. A closer look suggests otherwise. Most of the bicycle stations had been placed in parks, which are pleasant places to ride, rather than near offices and railway stations, where people actually need to travel. Wet days, it turns out, made little difference to how often the bicycles were used.

Which sentence means the same as the third sentence of the text?

options.en: Most stations were put where riding is pleasant instead of where people have to go.
Most stations were put near offices and railway stations, which are places where few people ride.
Most stations were put in parks, because that is where people need to travel.
The stations in parks were used less on wet days than those near offices.

why.en: "in parks, which are pleasant places to ride, rather than near offices and railway stations, where people actually need to travel" = pleasant places instead of needed ones.
why.uz: «in parks ... rather than near offices and railway stations, where people actually need to travel» — kerakli joylar oʻrniga yoqimli joylarga. Yomgʻir deyarli farq qilmagan.
why.ru: «in parks ... rather than near offices and railway stations, where people actually need to travel» — в приятных местах вместо нужных. Дождь почти ничего не менял.

stem.en:
The theatre group at Hollow Lane began as a way for retired people to meet. Its first plays were short and simple, and few people outside the group came to watch. Over ten years, however, the group has grown more ambitious, and its version of an old comedy sold out every night last winter, drawing an audience of all ages. Younger actors have started to join as well.

Which statement agrees with the text?

options.en: The group now draws people of every age, not only retired people.
The group was started in order to put on ambitious plays for young people.
Few people outside the group came to the comedy last winter.
The plays of the group have become shorter and simpler over time.

why.en: The comedy sold out, "drawing an audience of all ages". The group began "as a way for retired people to meet", and its plays grew more ambitious, not simpler.
why.uz: Komediya chiptalari sotilib ketgan, «drawing an audience of all ages». Guruh «as a way for retired people to meet» boshlangan; spektakllar murakkablashgan.
why.ru: Комедия шла с аншлагом, «drawing an audience of all ages». Группа начиналась «as a way for retired people to meet»; спектакли стали сложнее, а не проще.

stem.en:
Nobody disputes that the new dam has given the region a reliable supply of electricity. What is argued about is its effect on the river below it. Fishermen say their catches have fallen since the dam was built, while the company that runs it insists that the fall began years earlier and has other causes. A team from outside the region will look at the river next year.

Which sentence means the same as the third sentence of the text?

options.en: Fishermen blame the dam for their smaller catches, but the company says the fall began long before and has other causes.
Fishermen and the company agree that the dam has reduced the number of fish.
The company admits that the catches have fallen because of the new dam, while the fishermen blame the fall on other causes.
Fishermen say their catches have risen since the dam was built, but the company disagrees.

why.en: Fishermen blame the dam; the company "insists that the fall began years earlier and has other causes". They do not agree, the sides are not swapped, and catches fell.
why.uz: Baliqchilar toʻgʻonni ayblaydi; kompaniya esa «insists that the fall began years earlier and has other causes». Ular kelishmagan, tomonlar almashmagan, baliq ovi kamaygan.
why.ru: Рыбаки винят плотину; компания же «insists that the fall began years earlier and has other causes». Они не согласны, стороны не перепутаны, улов упал.

stem.en:
When a supermarket opened on the edge of Penhallow, few expected the small shops of the town to survive. Some did close. But the butcher, the baker and the hardware shop are still there, and their owners give the same reason: they offer advice and repairs that the supermarket does not, and their customers will pay a little more for that. Two of them have even taken on new staff.

Which statement agrees with the text?

options.en: Some small shops have stayed open by offering services that the supermarket lacks.
All of the small shops in the town closed after the supermarket opened.
The small shops survived because their prices are lower than those in the big supermarket.
The supermarket now offers advice and repairs, as the small shops do.

why.en: They survive because "they offer advice and repairs that the supermarket does not". Only "some" closed, and customers "pay a little more", so prices are not lower.
why.uz: Ular saqlangan, chunki «they offer advice and repairs that the supermarket does not». Faqat «some» yopilgan; xaridorlar «pay a little more», narx arzon emas.
why.ru: Они выжили, потому что «they offer advice and repairs that the supermarket does not». Закрылись лишь «some»; покупатели «pay a little more» — цены не ниже.

stem.en:
The orchard at Kelby was planted to grow apples for cider, and for most of its history that is all it did. When the cider mill closed, the owners feared they would have to cut the trees down. Instead, they opened the orchard to the public, who now pay to pick their own fruit, and the income is higher than the mill ever paid.

Which sentence means the same as the second sentence of the text?

options.en: After the mill shut, the owners were afraid that the trees would have to go.
After the owners cut the trees down, the cider mill closed.
When the mill closed, the owners hoped to cut down the trees and sell the wood.
Before the mill closed, the owners were afraid that it would cut down their trees.

why.en: "When the cider mill closed" = "After the mill shut"; "feared they would have to cut the trees down" = "afraid that the trees would have to go". The order and the fear stay.
why.uz: «When the cider mill closed» = «After the mill shut»; «feared they would have to cut the trees down» = «afraid that the trees would have to go». Tartib va xavotir saqlangan.
why.ru: «When the cider mill closed» = «After the mill shut»; «feared they would have to cut the trees down» = «afraid that the trees would have to go». Порядок и страх те же.

stem.en:
Critics of the new science museum in Aldra say it has too few objects and too many screens. The director of the museum accepts that the balance has changed but rejects the idea that this is a loss. Screens, she argues, let visitors handle things they could never touch in real life, such as a working heart or a forming star, while the most fragile objects are better protected in storage.

Which sentence means the same as the second sentence of the text?

options.en: The director agrees that screens now take a bigger share than objects, but she does not see this as a loss.
The director agrees with the critics that the museum has lost something important by adding so many screens.
The director denies that the number of screens has grown.
The director wants to bring the balance back towards objects.

why.en: "accepts that the balance has changed" = agrees screens now take a bigger share; "rejects the idea that this is a loss" = does not see it as a loss.
why.uz: «accepts that the balance has changed» — ekranlar ulushi oshganini tan oladi; «rejects the idea that this is a loss» — buni yoʻqotish deb bilmaydi.
why.ru: «accepts that the balance has changed» — признаёт, что экранов стало больше; «rejects the idea that this is a loss» — не считает это потерей.
